item.title: Surveillance video from strip mall may help find man's killer, HPD says
item.description: According to authorities, the incident happened along South Kirkwood near Waldemar. Investigators said they are looking for surveillance video from a strip mall to try to find the killer.

item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of 3 Doors Down, dies at 47 after cancer battle
item.description: Brad Arnold, founder and lead singer of 3 Doors Down, has died after a battle with cancer. He was 47.

item.title: 75-acre wildfire in Sam Houston National Forest, crews conduct water drops: Forest Service
item.description: The U.S. Forest Service says a wildfire in the National Forest in northwest Montgomery County is fully contained, and there is no public threat.
